notes.title: Release Date...
notes.content:
We would like to inform you that the world premiere of Cyberpunk Naughty Girls XXX is planned for the end of 2021. We decided to change the game's release date because the quality of the game is our top priority. We want to create a good, polished game in the world of cyberpunk. We will also create new, very interesting features, including the possibility of creating and managing your own nightclub, buying real estate in a naughty city and many more ...

We will inform you about the details soon.
